_comment: NAVCORE-SoOP deviations from MatekH743. Rev A = none (bit-identical, stock firmware runs). Rev B reassigns only pins MatekH743 spends on sensors this board does not have.

PC4.why: no airspeed sensor on a quad. ADC1 ch4 - I channel

PA4.why: single battery. ADC2 ch18 - Q channel, sampled simultaneously with ADC1

PC5.why: RSSI comes over CRSF telemetry. Reused for MAX2112 analogue RSSI/AGC readback

PA7.why: single battery. Left as a test point / spare ADC1 ch7

PE10.why: hardware time sync from companion; flow control unused at 921600 over 5cm

board_notes.PB10/PB11: I2C2 - MS5611 baro @0x77 (NOT DPS310 @0x76 - DPS310 unstocked at LCSC)
board_notes.PB6/PB7: I2C1 - VL53L1X ToF @0x29 + external compass on GPS port
board_notes.PD4: EXT_CS1 - PMW3901 flow (hwdef already declares SPIDEV pixartflow SPI3)
board_notes.PB12: MAX7456_CS - NOT POPULATED (no analogue OSD). Keep pin reserved + pulled up.
board_notes.PB13-PB15: SPI2 - unused without OSD; broken out to test pads for future use
board_notes.PE1: UART8_TX repurposed as ESC TEL input for future BLHeli_32/AM32 RPM
board_notes.PB8/PB9: UART4 - TFmini-S rangefinder JST-GH port (outdoor altitude)
board_notes.PC4: ADC1 ch4  - I channel from OPA2374 difference amp
board_notes.PA4: ADC2 ch18 - Q channel, dual-simultaneous with PC4
board_notes.PC5: MAX2112 RSSI / AGC analogue readback (Rev B)

adc_design_note: I/Q reaches the MCU as TWO SINGLE-ENDED channels, not two differential pairs. VERIFIED from ArduPilot hwdef/scripts/STM32H743xx.py: PC4=ch4, PA4=ch18, PA7=ch7, PC5=ch8, and all four exist on BOTH ADC1 and ADC2 - which is what makes dual-simultaneous sampling possible. NOT VERIFIED: the exact INP->INN pairing for differential mode (st.com refused the datasheet download). STM32H7 differential mode uses fixed INP/INN pin pairs rather than arbitrary pin choice, and those INN pins are largely consumed by SPI1 here - so the design avoids ADC differential mode entirely rather than depend on an unconfirmed detail. The OPA2374 (already required for anti-aliasing) is configured as two difference amplifiers, doing diff->single-ended conversion AND the 2nd-order LPF in one stage. Better regardless of the INN mapping: higher CMRR, half the ADC channels, frees PC5 for AGC readback. CRITICAL: sample PC4 on ADC1 and PA4 on ADC2 in DUAL REGULAR SIMULTANEOUS mode - any I/Q sampling skew becomes a phase error, which corrupts the Doppler frequency estimate directly.
